simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גָּרוֹן (H1627) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גָּרוֹן (gârôwn) means the throat (as roughened by swallowing) First listed occurrence: Ezek 16 11.

definitions.full: H1627. garon [ גורן ] Jer 2:25 גורנך Kt see גָּרוֺן . גושׁ ( be hard , compare Arabic be hard , of hands, from toil). גָּרוֺן noun masculine Psa 69:4 neck, throat (connection with above √ dubious; Thes Rob-Ges (compare MV) from גרה in (assumed) sense of גרר of a dragging, scraping sound; compare מְגֵרָה ; yet √ perhaps גרן q. v.; Arabic (sub Frey Lane) front part of neck of camel, etc.) — ׳ג Isa 3:16 ; 58:1 ; suffix גְּרוֺנִי Psa 69:4 ; גְּרוֺנֵךְ Ezek 16:11 + Jer 2:25 Qr (Kt גורנך ); גְּרוֺנָם Psa 115:7 ; 149:6 , גְּרֹנָם 5:10 ; — throat ; 1 of the visible exterior (front) of throat, neck ג ׳נְטֻו֯וֺת Isa 3:16 outstretched of neck (= with outstretched neck); עַלגְּֿרוֺנֵךְ וְרָבִיד Ezek 41:19 and a chain upon thy neck . 2 throat , as capable of thirst Jer 2:25 ; as organ of speech בְגָרוֺן קְרָא Isa 58:1 (|| קוֺלֶ֑ךָ הָרֵם ), בִּג יֶהְגּוּ ׳לֹא Psa 115:7 ; also בִּגְרוֺנָם אֵל רוֺמֲמוֺת 149:6 high songs to God (be) in their throat ; compare גְּרוֺנִי נִחַר 69:4 my throat is parched (|| בְקָרְאִי יָגַעְתִּי ); so also גְּרֹנָם קֶבֶרמָּֿתוּחַ 5:10 their throat is an opened sepulchre .
